events.summary: Serra's Gargoyles watch the city though she has not been seen in twenty years.
events.quote: "Though Serra has not been seen for twenty years, her Gargoyles still watch over our city and punish the guilty."

events.summary: Murat doubts Serra ever existed.
events.quote: "The Matrons still say Serra is coming back. I bet she never even existed."

events.summary: Gulsen expects Serra to return to choose the Abbot's successor.
events.quote: "Soon, Serra will return and choose the Abbot's successor, else we are lost."

events.summary: Baris warns Murat to tread the road of righteousness.
events.quote: "Tread the roads of righteousness, Murat, lest you lose your way and be consumed."

events.summary: Irini Sengir mocks a renegade rallying the rabble as no true Crusader.
events.quote: "A renegade rallying the rabble does not a true Crusader make."

events.summary: Taysir tells Daria that Serra and Feroz are long dead but their spirit survives.
events.quote: "Serra, like Feroz, is long since dead. But remember, Daria: her spirit shall survive so long as the Homelands do."

events.summary: Ihsan's Shade laments that the dead hold no place among Serra Paladins.
events.quote: "Would that I could be a Paladin again, but the dead hold no place among their ranks."

events.summary: Ihsan's Shade denounces Baron Sengir as the source of his pain.
events.quote: "Beast. Defiler. The source of all my pain."

events.summary: Baris condemns Ihsan as a betrayer who shamed the Serra Paladins.
events.quote: He has brought shame to the Serra Paladins where none existed before.

events.summary: Eron the Relentless declares a truce: Aysen feeds his band and they do not kill them.
events.quote: "The people of Aysen feed us, and we don't kill them. That's my kind of truce."

events.summary: Daria feels an aether storm is wrong.
events.quote: "I do love the rain . . . but this storm feels somehow wrong, Taysir."

events.summary: Irini Sengir vows to take the Wizards' School from Reveka.
events.quote: Their sorcerers' school shall yet be ours."

events.summary: Joskun warns Zeki and his dead ship to keep their distance.
events.quote: Zeki and his dead ship had best keep their distance."

events.summary: Baron Sengir explains Zeki's dead crew is pragmatism.
events.quote: "Zeki sails with a dead crew not out of villainy, but pragmatism."

events.summary: Halina is pleased to see a Dwarf as powerful as Reveka.
events.quote: "It's nice to see a sister Dwarf in a position of such power

events.summary: Grandmother Sengir warns of the Cemetery Gate.
events.quote: "It keeps some out, yes. It also keeps others in!"

events.summary: Baron Sengir praises his Grandmother's mix of power and madness.
events.quote: "Rarely have power and madness been so delightfully wed as they have in our dear Grandmother."

events.summary: Taysir calls the werewolves the Baron's lieutenants.
events.quote: "The wolf-things are no mere beasts, but the lieutenants of the Baron."

events.summary: Reveka calls Irini Sengir Sengir's daughter in spirit.
events.quote: She is Sengir's daughter in spirit if not in blood."

events.summary: Daria sees the Baron in the face of every Sengir bat.
events.quote: "In the face of every one I see the Baron."

events.summary: Halina predicts Veldrane will die serving the Baron.
events.quote: One day, he'll go to die."

events.summary: Onatah doubts Labyrinth Minotaurs still live.
events.quote: "I doubt any Labyrinth Minotaurs still live—but then again, we Minotaurs are stubborn beings."

events.summary: Onatah calls on the song of Feroz, who delivered them.
events.quote: "Play the song of he who delivered us. Play the song of Feroz."

events.summary: Daria fears the Homelands are lost without Feroz's Ban.
events.quote: "Without the protection of Feroz's Ban, I fear the Homelands are lost."

events.summary: Chandler suggests stealing the Ebony Rhino with Joven.
events.quote: "That Rhino would fetch us a tidy sum, Joven. Perhaps it's time to make it ours."

events.summary: Grandmother Sengir threatens to ring her Apocalypse Chime.
events.quote: "One day, or another, perhaps I shall ring my pretty chime . . . loudly, so that all may hear."

events.summary: Zeki describes Baron Sengir's mercilessness.
events.quote: but the Baron keeps no mercy in his vault of horrors."
